game_title: C Archive · Ritchie and Bell Labs
game_concept: A puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow, a hollow of roosting bats: the cave miner must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the exit ledge while the while-loop condition stays true and glow-eyed lurkers keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Bat Hollow: a hollow of roosting bats
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 1: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Ritchie and Bell Labs.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the exit ledge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: CP1 Week 4: Ritchie and Bell Labs
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
